text:
Lina: Heads-up 7 MerchantPilot final readout is tomorrow. Need consolidated metrics + clear remediation narrative + a single expansion ask for exec sponsors. 11am PT dry run?
Omar: I can stitch the eval artefacts into the slides. Where are we with the canonical prompts and golden labels?
Priya: Using prompts in `s3://rp-pocs/merchantpilot/2026-v2/prompts.txt`. Golden labels are in `s3://rp-pocs/merchantpilot/2026-v2/labels.csv`. Ran a baseline overnight.
Priya: Baseline numbers (10k eval): intent macro-F1 0.879, refund trigger FPR 3.1%, E2E latency p95 = 260ms, cost est $0.099/1k.
Lina: Ok a couple misses: F1 slightly below target 0.88, latency above target. Need remediation plan bullets and ETA.
Omar: Early hypothesis: prompt leakage and many short messages causing high token overhead. Also cold-workers causing latency spikes.
Priya: Agreed. Quick experiments: 1) prompt compression (strip metadata), 2) add one-shot canonical examples, 3) enable KV cache warmup. Running now.
Tom: Security runbook: customer asked about key separation, CVE patching cadence, and data access logs. I have a checklist; will include KMS policy snippet.
Dana: For latency, KV cache warmup and steady-state batching help. I can simulate a 5-minute warmup in staging and capture p95 curves. We should show first-5-min vs steady-state.
Ben: Commercial ask: if they choose Dedicated with 4x A10 equiv reserved monthly, what uplift vs hosted? I need to prepare a single ask number and an alternate conservative option.
Lina: Make the ask concrete. We prefer one recommended package + one fallback. Keep numbers round.
Priya: Experiment results (fast run): prompt compression + one-shot -> F1 0.889, FPR 2.4%, model infer latency unchanged. With KV warmup simulated: E2E p95 drops to 234ms steady-state, cold-start window still ~450ms. Cost after compression ~ $0.093/1k.
Omar: Good. Can you paste the minimal diff for prompts so I can show "what changed"?
Priya: Here's the patch to apply to prompts (one-line example):
```
- [METADATA] merchant_id=MP-123 | msg=Customer replied: "I want a refund"
+ msg=Customer replied: "I want a refund"
+ example: "Intent: request_refund"
```
Priya: That normalization and adding a single explicit example fixed several edge cases (currency tokens, emoji).
Tom: For logs: propose retention 90 days, auto-redaction for PII fields, and a KMS policy with separate key per-customer for Dedicated. I'll paste exact policy in deck.
Dana: I'll attach the warmup script we used and a chart: timeline vs p95. Also add note: recommend a short pre-warm job on deploys when using Dedicated.
Ben: Pricing sketch: Hosted baseline (pay-as-you-go) vs Dedicated reserved (4x A10): proposed committed monthly $68k with 20% discount vs list. Alternate conservative = $45k/month reserved (2x) with limited SLA. I'll add per-token economics slide with 1M token examples.
Lina: Expansion ask wording suggestion: "Move to Dedicated reserved capacity (4 GPUs) with a 3-month commitment to validate stability and throughput. Ask: $68k/mo. Expected unit cost reduction ~30% vs hosted"
Omar: Also include deployment options for EU data residency. MerchantPilot requires EU for EU sellers. We can offer Private VPC in eu-central with region pinning. Add cost delta.
Priya: Final eval run (full 50k set after normalization + warmup sim): F1 = 0.893, refund FPR = 2.1%, E2E p95 steady = 236ms, cold-start top 5% = 460ms, cost = $0.091/1k.
Lina: That's within targets for metrics except cold-start. We should provide a mitigation note: pre-warm + fallback to smaller model for first-second latency.
Tom: For the execs, I'll add a short slide: compliance checklist (SOC2, ISO certs, pen-test cadence) and timeline for any missing artifacts.
Ben: I'll prepare the commercial slide with three options: 1) Recommended reserved (4x) $68k/mo, 2) Conservative reserved (2x) $45k/mo, 3) Hosted expansion (no commit) with usage forecast.
Dana: Action items: I -> deploy warmup job template; Omar -> consolidate slides; Priya -> attach eval CSV and sample diff; Tom -> paste KMS policy; Ben -> finalize pricing table.
ci-bot: pipeline: merchantpilot-readout-deck build succeeded (artifacts: s3://ci-artifacts/merchantpilot/readout-v3.pdf).
Lina: Dry run at 11am PT. Please be ready with your slides and one-liner for questions. We'll end with clear next-step owner and timeline.
Omar: I'll narrate the remediation tech story. Lina I'll DM the deck link 10m before.
Priya: Uploaded eval CSV and run logs to `s3://rp-pocs/merchantpilot/results/2026-03-21/`.
Lina: Great job team. See you at 11. :rocket:
